verdict.rationale: Codegen can run security/secrets scans on PRs and post review comments (codegen-docs-20), fix bugs and open PRs (codegen-docs-1, codegen-docs-4), and can be triggered from CI/CD pipelines on failures (codegen-docs-18), which together imply a path to alert-driven remediation. However, there is no explicit documentation of ingesting security alerts (e.g., Dependabot/CVE) and automatically validating + remediating them with an opened PR end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit security-alert ingestion/trigger mechanism, a documented validation step distinguishing false positives, and a concrete example of an alert-to-PR remediation workflow.
